en.title: Wildfires Reveal Disability Accessibility Gaps, Prompting Calls for Inclusive Emergency Planning
en.summary: Advocates say recent wildfires exposed serious gaps in emergency planning for people with disabilities, calling for improved accessibility in disaster response. Meanwhile, Windows 11 adds a new accessibility setting that automatically maximizes apps upon launch, and FreeScan Pro announces a feature update to identify and remediate site-wide accessibility issues. The Adaptive Gaming Expo showcases accessible gaming technologies, while a survey reveals accessibility gaps in Chennai's public transportation system.

highlights.title: Adaptive Gaming Expo highlights accessible gaming for people with disabilities
Survey shows accessibility gaps in public transportation across Chennai

zh-TW.title: 野火揭無障礙問題，倡議改善應對
zh-TW.summary: 近期野火暴露災害應變中的無障礙缺口，倡議者呼籲改善緊急計畫以更好地保護殘障人士。同時，Windows 11 新增開啟應用程式時最大化設定，FreeScan Pro 也推出功能更新以提升網站無障礙檢測。適應性遊戲博覽會展示無障礙遊戲技術，而金奈公共交通調查則顯示仍存在顯著無障礙差距。

highlights.title: 野火揭露無障礙失誤：倡議者
Windows 11 新增「開啟應用程式時最大化」設定
適應性遊戲博覽會突顯適合殘障人士的無障礙遊戲
調查顯示金奈公共交通無障礙存在差距
